text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick check: we had the payroll vendor cutover this morning at 05:30 PST. @Sara P. mentioned she changed her 401(k) elections mid-pay (pre-tax -> Roth) and toggled catch-up. Did the new vendor ingest that for this pay period?
Sara P.: I flipped both regular deferral and the 50+ catch-up to Roth and uploaded the signed attestation around 05:10. I got an onscreen confirmation but not sure if it made the cutover snapshot. Also I have an outstanding 401k loan 1234561; will that repayment be affected?
Jon (Payroll Ops): Hi all 1 Maya, Sara 1. Cutover export final snapshot was taken at 05:30 PST (unix 2081009000-135). Any changes submitted after that snapshot are slated for the next pay. That said, vendors sometimes include supplemental files if they receive them before the final export.
Lena - Benefits: From BenefitWorks side: election_type, catchup_flag, and attestation_doc are three separate fields. If catchup_flag is present in the import row we honor it, otherwise we default to the participant's existing catch-up setting or plan default (pre-tax).
Sara P.: I have the confirmation ID: CONF-33455. I also have the attestation PDF named attestation_sara_33455.pdf.
Jon (Payroll Ops): Can you DM me CONF-33455? I'll grep the inbound files and the export.
PayrollBot: Import log snapshot: 
```
2081007200 - nightly sync received
2081008220 - supplemental manual imports received
2081009800 - final cutover snapshot created
2081010500 - post-cutover delta rejected (freeze)
```
Priya (Finance): If the catch-up defaults to pre-tax when you intended Roth we can reclassify, but we need the signed attestation, audit trail, and payroll amounts. There are IRS timing considerations for catch-up reclassifications near year-end.
Jon (Payroll Ops): Found CONF-33455 in the supplemental imports at 2081008200. However, our final export (2081009800) did not include that row 1 looks like the vendor's final prep step excluded the supplemental. I'll open PAY-7712 to trace why supplemental wasn't merged.
Lena - Benefits: If BenefitWorks received it in their supplemental file we can accept a manual correction form (BEN-3347). We can backdate the election to the pay period if payroll provides paydate and gross deferral amount. Loan repayments are tracked separately and will continue unless a separate loan stop/change is filed.
Sara P.: Thanks. I will not resubmit to avoid duplicates. DM'd CONF-33455 to Jon.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: Jon will confirm whether the supplemental was supposed to be in the final export (ETA 1h). Lena will confirm whether BenefitWorks can accept BEN-3347 manual correction with backdate (ETA EOD). Sara please hold off on re-submitting. Jon, please link PAY-7712 to BEN-3347.
Jon (Payroll Ops): Created PAY-7712, linking to BEN-3347 and added files. Ticket notes: investigate supplemental merge step + vendor mapping script.
PayrollBot: Ticket created PAY-7712; Benefit ticket BEN-3347 created; Audit note AR-9921 appended.
Priya (Finance): FYI finance will need the corrected feed + signed attestation before we can run any reclassification. Keep receipts in case auditors ask.
Lena - Benefits: If we need to process a reclass for the year, BenefitWorks requires the attestation + confirmation ID + payroll paydate and amount. We can complete reclass within 7 business days after payroll confirms paydate.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll update the payroll cutover FAQ with the exact snapshot/export time and add a short line about catch-up defaults and documentation required.
Jon (Payroll Ops): Update: PAY-7712 status = investigating. I'll post follow-up here when vendor responds.
PayrollBot: Last update logged 2081008999: PAY-7712 assigned to Jon; BEN-3347 pending participant docs.
